BrochureContent.Content:
Spectacular country residence in a private setting

Savills and Tom Spillane & Company Ltd are delighted to present Swan House, Dromore Old, Kenmare, Co Kerry.
An impressive stone facade 6 bedroom property built c. 1998 set on an ultra-private site looking towards the majestic McGillicuddy Reeks. Swan House has been built to exacting standards and is in excellent decorative order. Its carefully thought out design maximises space and light throughout whilst framing and capturing the spectacular views of the surrounding Kerry landscape.

Upon arrival, impressive wrought iron gates, guide you onto a long treelined driveway which gradually ascends through the land passing two large storage areas and onto the main house. From here, the grounds and landscape begin to be appreciated. A double carport provides sheltered parking, whilst a large garage and greenhouse can be easily accessed. Swan House is a stunning property with a beautiful natural stone finish, tall chimney stack and a weathervane.

Stepping over the threshold, brings you to a spacious reception area that is flooded with natural light, has exposed stone walls and a tiled floor. To your left, you will find a sauna and games room, whilst the main house offers a spacious lounge/dining room which benefits from an impressive, reclaimed fireplace, direct access onto the patio/deck area and calming mountain range views. The welcoming kitchen/breakfast area benefits from a high level of clever storage and a solid fuel stove, this room offers superb views and also offers direct access onto the patio and deck. The ground floor also provides, a gym with independent external access, a home office and guest lavatory.

Making your way upstairs brings you to 6 double bedrooms, a shower room and a bathroom. Each room is designed to frame the surrounding landscape views and allow the maximum amount of natural light into the property. Extensive eaves storage can be found in the bedrooms and landing on the first floor. Moving into the gardens reveals a large patio and deck area with raised flower beds and large lantern lighting for evening illumination. This expansive area overlooks the lake and onwards to the McGillicuddy Reeks. This calming space is private and ideal for large gatherings. A detached greenhouse and raised vegetable beds can be found close to the main house and offer a great opportunity to create a kitchen garden.

The main house is cushioned by about 24 acres of land mostly set out in grassland and bounded by post and rail fencing in part. The land offers a variety of potential uses to include equestrian and agricultural. The private lake is stocked with natural brown trout which are indigenous to the area. The Blackwater river is located within a few yards of the property and is well known for Salmon fishing.

Swan House is very well located within a close proximity of Kenmare town, Sneem village and Waterville village. A choice of golf courses, The Kerry Way walking trails and Oyster bed Pier for enjoying water activities are all located within easy reach. Swan House is a unique property offering space, privacy and a spectacular setting.

Contact us today to arrange your individual viewing.

• Approx. 380 sq m / 4100 sq ft
  • About 9.71 ha / 24 acres
  • Double glazed teak and spring loaded sash windows
  • Private brown trout lake and islands.
  • Uninterrupted views of the McGillicuddy Reeks.
  • Large detached garage and greenhouse.
  • Septic tank / Private well water / GFCH
